role: Bootstrap the semantic ontology domain with vocabulary, axioms, and infrastructure nodes in four dependency-ordered layers.
detail: Implements semantic domain initialization (P1.8-E1/T003) across four layers: (0) DomainRegistration META_SCHEMA node for SemanticDomain; (1) 17 SemanticEdgeType SCHEMA nodes (IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, LACKS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, USED_FOR, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, ACHIEVES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES, CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF, DENOTES); (2) 4 LogicalAxiom META_SCHEMA nodes governing IS_A transitivity/asymmetry, CAUSES asymmetry, PART_OF transitivity; (3) DEPENDS_ON structural edge from domain:semantic to concept:integer. Post-bootstrap: patches existing WordSenseNodes with scope_context_count=0 and ensures categorical threshold EvolutionRule. Public entry point bootstrap_semantic_ontology() is async, idempotent, and gates all graph writes behind optional guardian notification (CANON A.21.4) via GuardianNotificationSink Protocol. Returns SemanticBootstrapResult dataclass with creation/existing/skipped counts. All nodes carry TAUGHT_PROCEDURE provenance with confidence 1.0.
constants: _GUARDIAN_MESSAGE='I\'m ready to learn semantic relationships - things like is a, has the property, causes, etc.'
gotchas: Layer 3 (DEPENDS_ON edge) silently skips if endpoint nodes absent (non-fatal); WordSenseNode patching logs warnings but continues on individual failures; guardian notification exception is fatal (re-raised as BootstrapError); no transitivity materialization per A.1 (query-time inference only); CAUSES transitivity explicitly deferred to E5 inner monologue (not applied automatically); structure assumes procedural ontology bootstrap runs first to create concept:integer
